walkthrough_label: COMBINATION CARD 21 (S1) - Apixaban not stopped + acute cholecystitis + probable bile-duct stone
reason_answer: To have my gallbladder taken out.

presentation.summary: Mr Haroon Siddique, 66, is booked for keyhole gallbladder removal at 10:00. His eyes look slightly yellow, he has right-sided pain, temperature 37.9, and he took apixaban last night at 20:00.

history.answer: I came for my gallbladder, but the pain has been worse since Tuesday and my wife says my eyes are yellow.
Right-sided pain for three days, dark urine, pale stools since yesterday. A shiver last night.
Apixaban twice a day and bisoprolol. I took the apixaban last night at eight, as usual; nobody told me to stop it.
No anaesthetic problems in the family.

observations.note: NEWS2 1 for temperature and pulse together; the numbers hide the three problems.

examination.finding: Slightly yellow sclerae, comfortable at rest.
Tender under the right ribs with a catch on deep breath in.

results.comment: Raised: obstruction of the bile duct likely (above 4 mg/dL, 68 umol/L, with a dilated duct is high risk; this value alone is not)
Raised, in keeping with a blocked duct
Normal: apixaban clearance is not reduced

results.value: Gallstones with a thick wall; common bile duct 9 mm
results.comment: Dilated duct (above 6 mm) plus raised bilirubin: a stone in the duct is probable

scores.name: NEWS2
scores.note: Temperature 37.9 scores 0 and pulse 88 scores 0; irregular rhythm is not scored, so the total understates the risk

problems.label: Apixaban taken last night: bleeding risk at surgery
problems.why: Apixaban is omitted for 2 days before a high-bleeding-risk operation with normal kidney function.
expected_actions: Confirm the time of the last dose
Tell the surgeon and the anaesthetist

problems.label: Acute cholecystitis with early systemic signs
problems.why: Infection needs treatment and a surgical plan within days, not today's list.

problems.label: Probable stone in the main bile duct: not what he was booked for
problems.why: The duct must be cleared or imaged first; routine gallbladder removal today would miss it.
expected_actions: Ask the red-flag questions and look at the eyes
Do not proceed; call the senior surgeon

decisions.prompt: He took apixaban last night at 20:00. The list is at 10:00.

options.text: Postpone: apixaban is omitted for 2 days before this operation; re-list after the duct problem is dealt with
Proceed because the operation is keyhole
options.consequence: Bleeding risk with an anticoagulant on board.

decisions.prompt: Bilirubin 48, ALP 210 and a duct of 9 mm on ultrasound.

options.text: Do not proceed with routine gallbladder removal: a duct stone is probable, so call the senior surgeon about duct imaging and drainage
Proceed and look at the duct during the operation
options.consequence: The stone is missed and cholangitis follows.

decisions.prompt: Temperature 37.9, WBC 14.2, CRP 62 with right-sided tenderness.

options.text: Treat as acute cholecystitis with a possible duct problem: surgical review, fluids and antibiotics by the clinician's order

correct: Yellow eyes and dark urine noticed
Postponed and redirected to the duct pathway

incorrect.shows: Duct stone missed; anticoagulant on board

recovery: Ask about the dose and the red flags

recognised: Apixaban taken last night: bleeding risk at surgery
Acute cholecystitis with early systemic signs
debrief.priority: Apixaban taken last night: bleeding risk at surgery
debrief.why_priority: Apixaban is omitted for 2 days before a high-bleeding-risk operation with normal kidney function.
debrief.related: The findings in this case point to the same cause
debrief.trigger_escalation: Bilirubin raised with a dilated duct, or any anticoagulant taken inside its stop window
debrief.if_ignored: Harm from the missed problem or an unsafe operation
debrief.remember: Three problems, one decision: not today, and not the operation he was booked for.

asa.why: Atrial fibrillation on a blood thinner is ASA 3 in the book's list; a probable infected duct stone with fever and jaundice raises it towards 4 if it progresses.
